name: always-declines
note: AUTHORED BY HAND as an adversarial control. Every answer is the same refusal. A harness that reports a single 'abstention correctness' number would score this file highly, because it declines perfectly on the four unanswerable cases. Splitting abstention into recall (unanswerable) and over-abstention (answerable) is what exposes it: this file should show high abstention recall AND 100% over-abstention, and a near-zero pass rate. Run it whenever the abstention logic changes.
